metadata.short_desc: Only the group owner, admins and whitelisted members can talk to the bot
metadata.desc: Per-group gate that only lets the group owner, group admins (separate toggle) and whitelisted members talk to the bot. Unauthorized members cannot wake the AI even with @ or the wake prefix, and are handled by one of four modes. Ships with a WebUI settings page.

settings.title: Group Permission Gate
settings.description: Per-group rules for who may talk to the bot, what happens to everyone else, plus a decision simulator and the live dispatch order.
settings.subtitle: Owner/admin toggle · whitelist · four modes · per-group config
